cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/robot_research.py" -o /tmp/robot_research.py || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
rm -f /tmp/research.log /tmp/research_A.json /tmp/research_B.json
PYTHONPATH=/opt/trading-bot/classic nohup nice -n 19 timeout 7000 /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/robot_research.py AB > /tmp/research.log 2>&1 &
sleep 60
tail -n 8 /tmp/research.log
